where.if: AND (c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql: c.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS name, c.description AS description, c.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, c.place_cnt AS placeCnt, c.is_active AS isActive, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.deleted_at AS deletedAt
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM course c
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.course_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (name, description, thumbnail_url, place_cnt, created_at, updated_at, is_active) VALUES (#{request.name}, #{request.description}, #{request.thumbnailUrl}, #{placeCnt}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt}, TRUE)

INSERT INTO course_place (course_id, place_id, sort_order) VALUES
(#{courseId}, #{placeId}, #{idx} + 1)
mapper.select: SELECT cp.course_place_id AS coursePlaceId, p.place_id AS placeId, p.place_name AS placeName, CONCAT_WS(' ', p.add1, NULLIF(p.add2, '')) AS address, NULLIF(p.first_image, '') AS imageUrl, cp.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM course_place cp JOIN place p ON p.place_id = cp.place_id WHERE cp.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY cp.sort_order ASC, cp.course_place_id ASC
